description: Use this when someone asks what they can build on a plot or piece of land anywhere in Maharashtra outside Greater Mumbai: FSI or FAR, built-up area, setbacks (margins), height, how many floors, parking or approvals under UDCPR 2020, the building rules for every town in the state. People often ask in Marathi or Hindi, or mix them with English: जागा, प्लॉट, गुंठा, चटई क्षेत्र निर्देशांक (FSI), बांधकाम क्षेत्र (built-up), सामासिक अंतर (margins), किती मजले (how many floors), पार्किंग; give the area and road as they said them with area_unit and road_unit. Do not use for Greater Mumbai, for land prices or for building permission itself. Returns the UDCPR feasibility of one plot for one use: area statement, FSI, height limits, the margin on every side, the building that fits (and, where its floor is not a rectangle, the largest regular building inside it: building.regular), parking, water, sanitary fixtures, stairs and lifts, fire tanks, refuge area, open space and amenity space, and the NOCs the plot and building trigger; the floor counts around the fitted one (options) and the heights that change the rules (thresholds); the Proforma I area statement; premiums as shares of the ASR land rate, scrutiny fee and payment options; TDR loading; what applies (rainwater, solar, grey water, inclusive housing, open space, amenity, refuge, fire NOC); corner rounding; plot-origin options; power line clearance and TOD FSI when those inputs are given. Each value carries its UDCPR clause.

access_length.description: the plot does not abut a public street: the length of the access way to it, m, measured to the street; 'road' is then the access way's width (3.2.2, 3.3.3)

allotted_basic.description: for a plot of a plotted layout, the basic FSI area in m² the layout plan allots it (3.9(iii)), up to the most the plot may receive

area.description: plot area as the user gave it, in m2 unless area_unit says sqft, guntha, acre or hectare: the least of 7/12, measurement sheet and site

area_unit.description: unit of area, road_widening and reservation as the user gave them; default m2. Citiwise converts and says so in units

areas.description: the three areas of Appendix A item 1, in m2, for the area statement: ownership (the 7/12 or property card), sheet (the measurement sheet of the Land Records) and site (by the measurements); area is the least of those given

asr_rate.description: land rate of the plot in the Annual Statement of Rates, Rs a m2; gives premiums in rupees and the DRC to debit

avoid_special.description: true: keep the building out of the special building rules (1.3(93)(xiv)): no higher than 24 m, and for the uses the floor area reaches, each floor below 500 m² (750 m² for a sprinklered mixed building). Either way, special_choice sets the building kept out beside the special building, with what the special building brings

basement_flush.description: basement top flush with the ground: it may then run into the side and rear margins (9.11.1 proviso i)

basements.description: levels of basement, for parking and services (9.11)

bathrooms.description: factories: whether bath-rooms are provided, for water (Table 12-A)

beds.description: beds: for hospitals, parking, water, sanitation and grey water; for hotels, water

build_cost.description: construction cost, Rs a sq ft of built-up area

buy_premium.description: false: the study is drawn without premium FSI (and without the Table 7-A higher FSI, which is taken on premium), on basic FSI, any TDR and the ancillary area; default true

buy_tdr.description: false: the study is drawn without buying TDR, on basic and premium FSI with their ancillary area; default true. Either way, tdr_choice sets both side by side, with the most TDR is worth to this plot when sale_rate and build_cost are given

carpet.description: carpet area of a flat, m2

carpet_share.description: carpet area as a share of the built-up, 0.3 to 0.95 or 30 to 95 (default 0.8); sets the unit counts left out and so the sales value

crz.description: the coastal regulation zone the plot is in: I (between the tide lines), II, or III within its No Development Zone. No TDR in the coastal zone (11.2.8(c)); development as the CRZ Notification allows (1.6(i))

existing_built_up.description: authorised built-up of the existing building, m², with its TDR and premium FSI (7.5, 7.6)

existing_carpet.description: carpet area of the existing tenements together, m² (7.4.2, 7.6)

existing_kind.description: what stands on the plot, for redevelopment (7.4, 7.5, 7.6): a co-operative society's building, a tenanted building, a MHADA scheme building redeveloped by the society or by MHADA, or a bungalow; returns schemes with the figures

flats.description: number of flats; with carpet, a one-type unit mix

flood_zone.description: the plot lies within the blue flood line (prohibitive: no construction, no TDR) or between the blue and red flood lines (restrictive: plinth above the red flood line) (3.1.3; 11.2.8(b))

gaothan_belt.description: a Regional Plan village plot in the agricultural zone, within the belt around the gaothan or a town where 5.1.1 permits residential development, on a premium of a share of the land's ASR rate

green.description: green rating committed (IGBC / GRIHA / LEED tier) for the incentive FSI of 7.10 on basic FSI: 3%, 5% or 7%

internal_road_length.description: with layout_kind, the length of the longest internal road, m, from the farthest plot or building to the public street (3.3.3)

jda_offer.description: share of the flats a developer has offered the landowner in a joint development, %; with the rates, gives what the developer keeps at that share beside the share the plot carries

land_price.description: asking price of the land when it is being bought, Rs for the whole plot; with the rates, gives the profit at that price and how far it sits from what the land carries

land_use.description: the zone on the development or regional plan: residential, commercial, industrial, public / semi-public, agricultural, transport, green belt, loom industry cum residential (4.9), regional park (4.14), tourism development (4.15), afforestation (4.16), hill top (4.17), green zone 2 (4.18), forest, defence, mines and quarry, public utility, woodland corridor, special economic zone, airport (4.19 to 4.25)

layout_kind.description: the land is laid out into plots, or developed as a group housing scheme; returns layout: the internal road widths of Tables 3A to 3C and what the layout carries (3.3, 3.4, 2.7.2)

margin.description: margin the developer needs, % of sales value; with the rates, gives what the land carries and the largest share of the flats for the landowner in a joint development

measured.description: true: the polygon is the plot as measured on site (draw_plot gives it so), drawn as it is; area, the least of the areas of Appendix A item 1, may then be smaller than the polygon. Without it the drawing is scaled to area

other_costs.description: other costs (fees, finance, marketing), % of construction cost

papers.description: the papers the facts were read from, when they were: 712 (the 7/12 extract or property card, for the area), sheet (the measurement sheet, for the sides and area), zone (the zone certificate or DP remark, for the zone, the road width, road widening and reservations), layout (the sanctioned layout or regularisation order). The study marks each fact as read from its paper or as told; no rule reads them

parking_cost.description: construction cost of the stilt floor, Rs a sq ft; the stilt is free of FSI but built; default build_cost

plot_origin.description: layout: sanctioned layout or sub-division; unauthorised: sub-divided after 11.01.1967 without permission; gunthewari: regularised under the Gunthewari Act

polygon.description: plot corners [x, y] in m, anticlockwise, one per side, side 1 first; needed for plots that are not rectangles

power_line_kv.description: voltage of an overhead line near the plot, kV, for its clearance

prepared_by.description: who is giving the study, as it should appear on its cover, e.g. a broker or developer

prepared_for.description: who the study is for, as it should appear on its cover, e.g. the landowner or client

rc_rate.description: the ASR rate of RCC construction, Rs a m², for the land rate to construction rate ratio of Tables 7-C to 7-E

reservation_type.description: what the DP reservation on the plot is for; with 'reservation', returns accommodation_reservation: developing it by its owner under 11.1, Table 11-A

road.description: width of the road in front, in m unless road_unit is ft, when there is one road and no sides

road_unit.description: unit of road and of each road side's width as the user gave them; default m

road_widening_side.description: side number (1-based) that the road widening strip comes off; default the first road side

rooms.description: guest rooms, for hotel parking and sanitation

sale_rate.description: sale rate, Rs a sq ft of carpet area; with build_cost and tdr_rate gives an appraisal: sales value, construction, premiums, TDR and the surplus before land

sides.description: every side, anticlockwise, starting at a road

corner.description: true for the rounding or cut where two roads meet (3.3.12): margins run from it, but it is not a road of its own

side.description: for a curved or many-pointed side drawn as several segments: the side number each segment belongs to, the same on every segment of that side

width.description: DP road width in m, for roads

slum_tenements.description: eligible hutments on the plot, for slum rehabilitation (14.6, 14.7)

specified_area.description: Kolhapur: the characteristic specified area of Table 10-B (10.9.1) the plot is in, by Sr. No. ('1' for Rajarampuri) or the area's name; where the row has several plot sizes, Sr. No. and the plot row, e.g. '3.2'. Sets the Table 10-B margins and coverage and the Note 1 basic FSI. Pune: 'koregaon_park' (10.1.2). A Regional Plan area: an area of Chapter 5 with rules of its own, one of hill_station, station_near, station_far, tarapur, ratnagiri_pada, sindhudurg_t2, sindhudurg_t4, sindhudurg_t5, mp_buffer_edge, mp_buffer_gaothan, satara_core, satara_buffer, nagothane, wadi, rajpuri_usar, sector_r_lonavala, sector_r_kune, aurangabad_strip, ligo. Chapter 10 city areas, Pune: parvati_chatushrungi, arde, hemrl; Thane: ram_maruti, gokhale, express_highway, chemical_green_belt, chemical_low_density, air_force, defence_buffer, g1_yeur, g3_forest, eco_sensitive, defence_west_orange, defence_west_pink, defence_west_navy_blue, defence_west_yellow, defence_west_violet, defence_west_green, defence_east_orange, defence_east_pink, defence_east_yellow, defence_east_violet, defence_east_sky_blue; Nashik: tps1, gangapur_ambad; Vasai-Virar: low_density, eco_sensitive; Mira-Bhayandar: road_strip, manori_gorai_uttan, eco_sensitive; NMRDA: ring_road, township, gaothan_small, gaothan_large

sprinklers.description: mixed building fully sprinklered with the travel distances kept: under the 1.3(93)(xiv) note it stays out of the special building rules up to 24 m with floors up to 750 m², subject to fire NOC

steep_area.description: m² of the plot steeper than 1 in 5: hill top and hill slope land, not built upon (3.1(iii); 4.0 (XIV))

step_margins.description: true: step margins on upper floors (6.2.3(c)): each floor keeps the side and rear margin its own height needs, so lower floors are larger; 6 m at the ground for a special building

tdr_generating_rate.description: ASR land rate of the TDR's generating plot, Rs a m2 (11.2.6)

tdr_rate.description: price of TDR, Rs a sq ft

tod.description: plot inside a TOD zone (14.2): Municipal Corporations, metropolitan authorities and CIDCO; the Nagpur Metro Rail Corridor by Table 14-P

town.description: Maharashtra town, city or planning authority, e.g. Pune, Kolhapur, Nashik, PMRDA

units.description: the unit mix, one entry per type, e.g. [{"type":"2 BHK","count":12,"carpet":60},{"type":"Shop","count":4,"carpet":25}]; parking takes each type in its own Table 8-B row; a count left out is worked out from the building

carpet.description: carpet area of one unit, m2, 10 to 2000

count.description: units of this type, 0 to 10000; leave out to work it out

per_floor.description: instead of count: units of this type on each typical floor, 0 to 200, repeated on every floor that carries units

share.description: with count left out: this type's share of the carpet area, 0 to 1 or a percentage

share_of_units.description: with count left out: this type's share of the units, as a developer gives a mix (60 for 60% 2 BHK), 0 to 1 or a percentage; the number of units is worked out from the building

type.description: label of up to 20 characters: 1 BHK, 2 BHK, Studio, Shop, Office

upper_floors.description: floors above ground or stilt (G+3 is 3); omit to fit

use_carpet.description: carpet area of a non-residential use, or of the shops below flats, m2, for its parking and water; default the built-up that fits

wings.description: a group housing project as wings, each with its own typical floor and floors; units then gives each type and its carpet only. Returns each wing's height, lifts, special building and the distance between wings (6.2.4), and the built-up the wings need against what the rules allow

floors.description: floors of this wing that carry units, 1 to 60; left out, those of the building that fits

name.description: the wing's name, up to 12 characters: A, B, Tower 1

per_floor.description: units of that type on this wing's typical floor, 0 to 200

type.description: one of the types in units

name: feasibility
